brief.story: Movie-inspired Avengers cooperative raid: Thor, Doctor Strange and Iron Man defend a fractured New York rooftop against Thanos. Preserve these character names and make each hero visibly distinct using the supported 3D parts. Cooperation, rift travel and Reality Breach decide the fight.
brief.environment: Rainy nighttime New York rooftop. Blue-gray metal/stone ground, ruined towers and glowing portal crystals. Place decorative props outside the playable circle (at least 8 units from center).
brief.powers: Thor: hammer, blue armor, lightning ultimate. Doctor Strange: red cape, mage form, magical fists and moon-shield ultimate. Iron Man: red/gold tech armor, fists and fire-orb repulsor ultimate. Thanos: large gold/purple armored humanoid, gauntlet-like fists, two visibly different boss attacks. Balance a 2-4 hero raid.
brief.controls: Thor: J strike, I kick, K guard, L evade, E jump, Space ultimate. Doctor Strange: U strike, O kick, P guard, H evade, N jump, M ultimate. Iron Man can use default hero keys. Each hero uses the six canonical distinct physical gestures for its six actions. Explain exact supported mappings.

spec.title: Avengers: Reality Breach
spec.introLine: Thor, Doctor Strange, Iron Man—hold the rooftop! Thanos is tearing New York apart.
spec.victoryLine: The last breach closes. Above a rain-soaked New York, the Avengers stand together.

creation.context: A cooperative, movie-inspired rooftop showdown: Thor, Doctor Strange and Iron Man defend fractured New York against Thanos. Use 130 as base boss HP before squad-size scaling for 2–4 players. Three distinct hero designs are available; a fourth player can reuse a design. At half health, Thanos enters phase two. Coordinate defenses and stagger ultimates around Reality Breach.
creation.explanation: All designs use procedural supported parts, not actor likenesses or downloaded assets. Every design, power, key and control mapping is editable. Keys are hero-local: Thor J/I/K/L/E/Space; Strange U/O/P/H/N/M; Iron Man 1/2/3/4/5/6, ordered strike/kick/guard/evade/jump/ultimate. Exact gesture mappings for every hero: punch=arm extension or palm swipe; kick=knee lift; guard=cross wrists or fist; dodge=duck; jump=one hand overhead or index up; special=both hands overhead or pinch. These recognizers,

heroes.name: Thor
heroes.description: Broad blue-armored knight with silver trim, a red cape and a chunky hammer. Lightning marks his attacks.

abilities.name: Mjolnir Strike
abilities.description: J or punch gesture: a compact hammer blow, approximated through the punch slot.

abilities.name: Asgardian Boot
abilities.description: I or knee lift: drive an armored kick into Thanos.

abilities.name: Hammer Ward
abilities.description: K or crossed wrists/fist: brace behind a pale defensive ward.

abilities.name: Storm Sidestep
abilities.description: L or duck: evade a marked impact; duck approximates the sidestep command.

abilities.name: Thunderbound
abilities.description: E or one hand overhead/index up: leap over the low breach wave.

abilities.name: Call the Lightning
abilities.description: Space or both hands overhead/pinch: unleash a brilliant blue lightning ultimate.

heroes.name: Doctor Strange
heroes.description: Slim blue-robed mage with dark hair, a crimson cape and glowing magical fists.

abilities.name: Mandala Fist
abilities.description: U or arm extension/palm swipe: strike with a glowing spell-wrapped fist.

abilities.name: Astral Heel
abilities.description: O or knee lift: deliver a crescent-lit kick.

abilities.name: Seal of Protection
abilities.description: P or crossed wrists/fist: raise a circular magical guard.

abilities.name: Rift Feint
abilities.description: H or duck: evasive movement with a rift-colored flourish, not a teleport.

abilities.name: Cloak Lift
abilities.description: N or one hand overhead/index up: a short cloak-assisted jump, not sustained flight.

abilities.name: Moon-Shield Convergence
abilities.description: M or both hands overhead/pinch: invoke the moon-shield ultimate; its closing seal strikes Thanos.

heroes.name: Iron Man
heroes.description: Compact red-and-gold tech armor with a full mask, luminous cyan accents and gauntlet-like fists.

abilities.name: Servo Strike
abilities.description: 1 or arm extension/palm swipe: land a powered gauntlet punch.

abilities.name: Thruster Heel
abilities.description: 2 or knee lift: deliver a jet-assisted armored kick.

abilities.name: Armor Lock
abilities.description: 3 or crossed wrists/fist: brace armored forearms behind a luminous guard.

abilities.name: Vector Evasion
abilities.description: 4 or duck: a short evasive maneuver, not free flight.

abilities.name: Booster Hop
abilities.description: 5 or one hand overhead/index up: hop above the breach wave.

abilities.name: Repulsor Overcharge
abilities.description: 6 or both hands overhead/pinch: launch a concentrated fire-orb repulsor ultimate.

boss.name: Thanos
boss.description: An oversized purple armored humanoid built from colossus parts, gold plates and enormous gauntlet-like fists. His orange projectile and violet ground wave have distinct silhouettes
